name: JSON Validator
description: Validates JSON data against named schemas. Strips prefixes, extracts from markdown, checks required fields. Returns cleaned JSON or specific error messages.

inputs.description: Raw data to validate (may have prefixes, markdown wrapping, etc.)
Schema name: project-context, plan-steps, step-result, test-results

outputs.description: When valid: the parsed JSON data directly (pass-through). When invalid: {isValid: false, errors: [...], parsed: null}
